merge_corrections.what: ONE MECHANICAL CORRECTION, and it RAISES a status rather than lowering one. 26 EN 17007 citations were submitted as clause-verified. EN 17007:2017 is held in full by this project, so its ceiling is 'verified' and clause-verified under-claims it - which understates the reference rather than over-claiming. No citation text changed; only the status. Nothing else in the file was touched.
accepted_from_submitter: Fifty-two controls, every one unique across twenty-six processes, replacing the three repeated templates that were the rejection grounds. The third of those templates - field assignment must apply job-briefing, information-transfer and qualification requirements - was true of every field process in the model and told a reader nothing about metering; its replacements are about read reliability, estimation and tamper evidence.
Twenty-six process-specific judgment citations replacing one category-wide disclaimer, done in the same pass and without being rejected for it.
IEC 61968-9 and -4 cited at consensus rather than clause-verified because no clause locator was available. Correct, and the right call rather than inventing a clause number.
Sixteen artifacts for twenty-six processes - six group BPMN, six DMN, four CMMN - which is the granularity rule applied exactly.
merge_corrections.models_built_here: Sixteen artifacts, 6 BPMN, 6 DMN and 4 CMMN.
merge_corrections.open_finding: The category does not use the words meter shop, billing or premise state. Client material shows a meter is operated on at a billing-active premise, at an inactive premise, or in the shop, and that disposal is a shop act - which also settles 6.1.4 (retire the RECORD) against 6.4.5 (condemn the UNIT). Recorded here for the enrichment pass; not changed at merge, because it is programme practice and belongs in a P-graded revision written product-neutrally.
merge_corrections.open_finding_notation_why: OPEN FINDING, ADDED AFTER THE MERGE NOTE ABOVE WAS WRITTEN. That note said no correction was needed, and on the two rejection grounds it was right. Building the behaviour models surfaced a third instance of the same defect family: notation.why - the rationale for why a process is drawn in a given notation - is one text on 16 of the 26 processes. It states the notation RULE ('the process has a repeatable start, ordered activities and a defined completion outcome') rather than which repeatable start THIS process has. Nothing in it is false; it is the BPMN test, correctly applied. But fifteen of the seventeen merged categories carry a distinct rationale on every process and none shares one on more than two. Recorded rather than fixed, and now a WARNING in validate_spec.py - the third check of this shape after control reuse and judgment-citation reuse. The pattern across all three is the same: a category-level truth put where a process-level one belongs, in a file that passed every other check because the field was populated.

derivation: STANDARDS-DERIVED. IEC 61968, EN 17007, APQC structural precedent and SMRP supply the permitted authority. Unsourced operating detail is labelled judgment.
field_set: EN 17007:2017 cl. 5.2 maintenance process profile, corroborated by ISO 9001 cl. 4.4.1 a) to h).
gaps: The Source Authority Pack contains no detailed meter accuracy, proving, certification, calibration or estimation standard. IEC 61968-9:2024 Ed. 3 establishes meter reading and control scope but its clause bodies are paywalled and are not paraphrased.

No permitted source defines endpoint programming parameters, firmware governance, commissioning acceptance thresholds, communication signal thresholds, tamper rules, revenue-estimation methods or recovery periods. These remain judgment.
No metering-specific measure is permitted by the campaign measure vocabulary. SMRP work-management measures are used only for associated work and exception workloads.
APQC 14.3.4 Aggregate and distribute data is partial: pcf_id 19324 Pass consumption data to market participants has no model home because the reference stops at validation.

APQC 14.4.4 Operate Advanced Metering Infrastructure is partial: pcf_ids 19338 to 19341 for the operating centre, network-performance monitoring and network faults have no model home; 6.3 commissions endpoints only.
IEC 61968-6 remains electric-scoped, while IEC 61968-9:2024 Ed. 3 extends to gas and water metering. Gas uses the CIM Work vocabulary here despite the cross-commodity gap.
